name: catchthat
description: A private, local-first workflow for archiving authorized Snapchat Web chats offline.

interface.longDescription: Turn a user-supplied transcript or a user-approved, visible-DOM capture of the currently open Snapchat Web chat into a searchable, read-only offline archive. CatchThat preserves provenance, media placeholders, visible profile metadata, coverage limits, and integrity checks; it never logs in, searches accounts, sends messages, reads browser stores, fetches remote media, or runs in the background.
defaultPrompt: Build an offline archive from this local capture.
Capture the Snapchat chat I have open, one approved range at a time.
Prepare a redacted, encrypted share bundle.
